name: Greasy Luck

perks.name: Ballistic Tuning
perks.desc:
Power diverted from shield.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases shield duration

perks.name: Supercooled Accelerator
perks.desc:
Optimized for extended range.
  •  Increases range
  •  Slightly decreases reload speed
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Tempered Truss Rod
perks.desc:
High stiffness for quick handling.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases reload speed
  •  Slightly decreases range

perks.name: Low-Impedance Windings
perks.desc:
Improved output efficiency.
  •  Increases shield duration
  •  Slightly increases reload speed
  •  Decreases range

perks.name: Auxiliary Reserves
perks.desc:
Additional energy storage.
  •  Greatly increases shield duration
  •  Decreases reload speed

perks.name: Lightweight Emitter
perks.desc:
Weight reduction for better agility.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Decreases shield duration

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.desc: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Swap Mag
perks.desc: Increases this weapon's ready and stow speed.

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Melee Momentum
perks.desc: Melee final blows with this weapon grant it bonus energy and provide increased movement speed while blocking.

perks.name: Beacon Rounds
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant your projectiles tracking and increase reload speed. Dealing further damage extends the duration.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.desc: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Heal Clip
perks.desc: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

perks.name: Replenishing Aegis
perks.desc: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.desc: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Immovable Object
perks.desc: Dealing ranged damage grants increased weapon energy while you're stationary with your shield raised.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.desc: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.desc: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.desc: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

perks.name: Butterfly
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing causes your target to explode the next time you deal final blows. Timer resets when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Unstoppable Force
perks.desc: Blocking damage with your shield increases projectile damage for a short time.

perks.name: Redirection
perks.desc: Damaging rank-and-file combatants increases damage against more powerful ones.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.desc: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Close to Melee
perks.desc: Glaive projectile final blows improve Glaive melee damage. Glaive projectile or melee damage extends the duration.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Box Breathing
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

perks.name: Mega Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a final blow grants a period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

perks.name: Restoration Ritual
perks.desc: Reviving allies or defeating combatants with finishers reloads this weapon and readies an emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo.

perks.name: Gravity Well
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon automatically gathers nearby ammo.

notes: warlockmaggie (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Greasy Luck, like other Rapid-Fires, is really best used for Melee combat (lowest shot damage, range, and shield duration), but unfortunately, only 2 Perks (one for each column) actually work with that: Melee Momentum and Close to Melee. Otherwise, you can try established perk combos (Incandescent and Heal Clip), but since they only proc with projectile kills, well... that's glaives for you." Recommended MW: Shield Duration or Range.

warlockmaggie (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Glaives in PvP tend to have a truly hit or miss tendancy. If you want to bring up the shield duration, Replenishing Aegis and Unstoppable Force can give you a more rounded option. But to actually lean into the archetype, you'll want the two melee perks instead (plus some extra handling never hurts)." Recommended MW: Handling or Shield Duration.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Shield Duration. Rapid-Fire Glaive(80) Solar Glaive Special Ammo. "Greasy Luck sounds weird to say but is an all around good glaive. Lead from Gold works with the rise of double special weapon builds. Disruption Break is fantastic on a glaive for those ranged shields and keeps another good perk like Incandescent. It’s no longer an either-or. Redirection will be really strong on Greasy Luck if you use it right, I do not know how it interacts with the melee, so you’ll have to report back to me on that one use case."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Range or Shield Duration. Rapid-Fire Glaive(80) Solar Glaive Special Ammo. "In PvP I can see more blinting possibilities with Greasy Luck. Tied with the highest base handling at 61 with Unexpected Resurgence and shooting faster I can see a lot of players using this weapon to swap almost like a bow, but with a shield. Opening Shot also makes this a really compelling argument. With Disruption Break you can swap to your kinetic and deal 50% more damage, the projectile for Greasy Luck does 105 damage, almost enough to break all tier’s shields. Could be fun, let me know how it feels glaive users."

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 67 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3wGaXiUGMNodLkPkGFdBd3?si=42e0db2e63a443b7) with @CourtProjects, @ImpetusAlways and @Saint_Kabr. First-choice PvE pick for minor add clear in general activities. The first rapid-fire legendary glaive, which looks like it offers high rate-of-fire, handling and reload speed, but lower range, impact and shield duration. Supercooled Accelerator seems like the best of the haft perks to boost the range, or Auxiliary Reserves helps shore up the Shield Duration, both at the cost of one or both of handling and reload. There's not really a top pick for your mag, except to avoid Extended Mag. For glaive melee fans, the combination of Disruption Break in the first trait slot as the support perk weakens targets by 50% to kinetic damage for 5.5s once you've broken their shield with a glaive bolt and guess what? Glaive melees are kinetic, so you can slash away to your heart's content. If enemies don't have a shield, Close to Melee in the second column as the signature perk boosts your glaive melee damage by 30% for 10s for getting a projectile kill, with the timer being refreshed by 5s after another melee kill. The Restoration Ritual origin trait is also occasionally useful for an instant reload after proccing. Recommended MW: Stability, with a damage-boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) or Backup Mag mod.
